values.tutorial.title: Codex skin tutorial — from engine to applied theme
values.tutorial.description: A fuller walkthrough for applying a Codex skin: install an engine, pick a skin, copy the prompt, apply, and restore.
values.tutorial.subtitle: A longer walkthrough for applying your first Codex skin and keeping it reversible.
values.tutorial.steps.1.title: Install an engine once
values.tutorial.steps.1.body: Clone or download a skin engine such as Codex Dream Skin, or use a manager like Codex Skin Manager. This is a one-time setup on your machine.
values.tutorial.steps.2.title: Find a skin in the index
values.tutorial.steps.2.body: Browse categories or search by mood and color. Open the skin page to see its description, compatible platforms, and the exact install prompt.
values.tutorial.steps.3.title: Copy and apply
values.tutorial.steps.3.body: Click Copy on the install prompt, paste it into Codex Desktop, or run the CLI command. The workspace updates immediately.
values.tutorial.steps.4.title: Verify and keep the source
values.tutorial.steps.4.body: Confirm the new look, then bookmark the source link. If Codex updates and a skin breaks, re-run the source restore step to return to stock.
values.tutorial.tips.1: Start with a featured skin — it is the most likely to apply cleanly through the engine\'s default preset.
values.tutorial.tips.2: Copy the exact prompt text; small edits can change what the engine applies.
values.tutorial.tips.3: Keep the source link handy so you can restore or re-apply after a Codex update.
values.tutorial.tips.4: Use the category and mood filters to narrow 100+ skins to a handful that fit your taste.
values.tutorial.choosingEngineBody: The engine decides how skins are applied and which formats you can use. All are free and open source.
values.tutorial.troubleshootingBody: The four most common issues and their fixes.
